reason: The marker introduces a person by name and job title, and the reporting tag alone does not identify the speaker.
A marker tab names a spoken term and a separate rising slab explains it when Greg gives its meaning.
The lower bar links the speaker's name to a job title and affiliation.
The index tab categorizes a speaker whose name and job title fill the main panel.
The two main tiers are the speaker name and the job title.
The pinned note is a speaker ID built around a name and job title.
The rail anchors the name and job title as one speaker ID.
The avatar badge relies on a person's initials and pairs with the full name and job title.
The clapperboard identifies the subject by name and role.
The highlight is drawn behind a guest's name and the adjoining line is their job title.
The brackets frame an expert's name next to their job title and affiliation.
The stamp contains the on-record speaker's name and its subtitle supplies their job title.
The ribbon carries a reporter's name and the subtitle supplies their title and outlet.
The typeset card is a speaker credit that needs a name, job title and outlet.
Moving the drawn accent below the term to clear the words yields the same underline and explanation.
Two brackets move inward from opposite sides and the term writes out from center above a centered definition.
A folded term note drops from above at a fixed tilt and the level detail enters from below.
A gold stroke draws beneath the term itself above an indented definition.
A dedicated left gutter holds a falling diamond and extends a rule down beside the detail.
The asterisk and rule reduce to the same anchored two-row annotation and its detail rail.
Without the swing, the notched header drops in as the same folded term tab over a separate detail slab.
The term and detail share one horizontal band with separate columns and a dash that draws across the gap.
Dropping the supplied phonetics and inferred part of speech leaves a term, drawn rule and indented definition.
Dropping the frame-wide gradient leaves the same term tab wipe and rising explanatory slab.
The attribution and date can be removed while preserving a short quote of Greg's own and his independently revealed explanation.
The term writes into a solid lens that scales in and draws its handle before the definition appears below.
